facts.fact: Senegal's ministry opened a new phase of the Adressage Numerique National (ANN), initiated in 2021 and presented in 2023 as 'Un Senegalais, une adresse', with a relaunch workshop in early August 2026 and a pilot phase due within a year before progressive national extension, per We are Tech.

systems.owner: Ministere des Telecommunications et du Numerique
